# SidebarNavigation

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

The navigation column of a window: sections of items with icon, label and badge, one selected, keyboard and wheel, a compact icons-only mode ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation> CreateSidebarNavigation(const std::string& identifier, float x = -1, float y = -1, float w = -1, float h = -1);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasSidebarNavigation(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string& id)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onItemActivated` | `std::function<void(const std::string& id)> onItemActivated` | double-click or Return |
| `onCompactChanged` | `std::function<void(bool compact)> onCompactChanged` | _Compact changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
